episodes.title: Chapter 1: Doors
episodes.summary: When a terrifying intruder attacks her underground sanctuary, 16-year-old Eva is forced to leave behind her home and her robot caretaker, Muthr. Armed only with her survival skills and a cryptic note labeled WONDLA, she begins a search for other humans in an unfamiliar world.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: Lifeforms
episodes.summary: Having survived the attack on her sanctuary, Eva finds herself on a strange planet called Orbona. She meets a telepathic waterbear named Otto and a surly alien named Rovender who has a promising connection to humans.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: Bargain
episodes.summary: Rovender guides Eva and Muthr to the fishing village of Lacus to meet a duplicitous merchant of human antiques. To get the information they need, Eva must make a risky bet at the Spiderfish Races.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: Ghosts
episodes.summary: Eva tracks down the Arsian sage, Darius, who reveals a devastating account of humanity's last days. Eva doubles down on her quest to find other humans as the alien bounty hunter Besteel closes in.

episodes.title: Chapter 5: Captive
episodes.summary: Besteel delivers Eva to the capital city of Solas, where she finds an unlikely ally in the timid teenage Queen of Orbona.

episodes.title: Chapter 6: Bridge
episodes.summary: With a human civilization in sight, Eva leads a risky mission across the most perilous obstacle yet.

episodes.title: Chapter 7: Ruins
episodes.summary: Eva learns the truth about humankind. Meanwhile, Besteel tracks Eva down for a final showdown.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: Eva arrives at the hidden city of New Attica, where she learns humans believe the worst about Orbona.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.summary: Eva chases a mysterious figure deep into New Attica, leading to the discovery of a group of outsiders.

episodes.title: Discovery
episodes.summary: Desperate to locate her friends, Eva is horrified to find them in the clutches of a sinister threat.

episodes.title: Lesson
episodes.summary: After a narrow escape, Eva, Eight, and Hailey trek the perilous wastelands to bring an injured Rovender home.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.summary: The Caeruleans refuse to let a dying Rovender back into their community. To save him, Eva seeks a mystical creature to restore his honor.

episodes.title: Connection
episodes.summary: During a Caerulean celebration, Eva connects with a powerful entity. Cadmus and his warbots bear down on Faunas.

episodes.title: Heart
episodes.summary: Season finale. Eva risks her life to protect the Heart of the Forest.

episodes.title: Rise
episodes.summary: After being left for dead, Eight braves the Orbona desert to expose Cadmus' lies and stage a revolt.

episodes.title: Return
episodes.summary: Eva wakes to a decimated Orbona and meets with Arius, the sage. Armed with a prophecy, Eva and Rovender head to Solas with a new goal.

episodes.title: Mission
episodes.summary: Loroc seizes power and declares war on the humans, prompting Eva to join forces with Queen Ojo and an ally with an eerily familiar face.

episodes.title: Monsters
episodes.summary: Eva reunites with Eight at last, only to learn that Eight is leading the human assault on Orbona. Torn and confused, Eva must choose a side.

episodes.title: Lost
episodes.summary: Amid the fog of war, Eva and the team search for the Heart of the Forest in a crumbling New Attica.

episodes.title: WondLa
episodes.summary: With the fate of the planet at stake, Eva fights to deliver the Heart into the thermal vent.
